threshold.boundary: GHSL built-up surface growth divided by GHSL urban population growth; an analytical implementation of the SDG 11.3.1 direction, not an official UN country score.

extent.boundary: Global sum across published GHSL country/territory records; no unweighted country averaging.

source_summary.measurement_boundary: This snapshot measures built-up surface expansion and built-up area per resident. It does not measure urban tree canopy, building height, informal-settlement status, service access, or causal drivers of urbanization.

transformations.formula: Sum GHSL built-up surface and urban population across all valid country/territory records for each epoch before calculating per-resident values.
Divide global built-up-surface percentage growth by global urban-population percentage growth; ratio above one means land consumption outpaces population.
Annualize the change in globally aggregated built-up area per urban resident over exactly five years.

receipts.uncertainty: Remote-sensing classification, population downscaling, GADM boundary adaptation, settlement-class transitions, epoch interpolation, and release revisions affect comparisons.
receipts.freshness: GHSL R2024A harmonized 2015-2020 historical epochs; snapshot captured 2026-07-18T21:29:20.357Z.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: GHSL supplies complete 2015 and 2020 built-up surface and urban population numerators for 230 country/territory records, a defensible summed global aggregation and an SDG-consistent land-versus-population threshold.
